headline: Three new city datasets, including work orders mapped across Halifax
dek: The municipality's Open Data catalogue now holds 294 free datasets.

facts.v: Cityworks Work Orders Geolocated; Municipal Operating Revenues and Expenses; Safe School Streets

body: The Halifax Regional Municipality released three new datasets on its Open Data site on Oct. 28: geolocated Cityworks work orders, municipal operating revenues and expenses, and Safe School Streets.
That brings the catalogue to 294 datasets. Others include transit routes and schedules, solid waste collection schedules and area rates. The previous release was on Sept. 9.
Open Data started in early 2014. Regional Council formalized it later that year with Administrative Order 2014-006-ADM.
means: Developers, researchers and curious residents can download all of it free from the city's Open Data page.
